ReportRelation.ReportRelationExpression: Left join vwdb_Customer on vwdb_Quotation.DestinationID = vwdb_Customer.CustomerID
Left join vwdb_Item on vwdb_Quotation.ItemID = vwdb_Item.ItemID
Left join vwdb_PaymentTerm on vwdb_Quotation.PaymentTermID = vwdb_PaymentTerm.PaymentTermID
Left join vwdb_Users on vwdb_Quotation.RequesterID = vwdb_Users.UserID
Left join vwdb_Contact on vwdb_Quotation.ContactID = vwdb_Contact.ContactID
Left join vwdb_SalesPerson on vwdb_Quotation.DSRID = vwdb_SalesPerson.SalesPersonID

ParameterSetup.ParameterFilter: vwdb_SalesPerson.SalesPersonID in (select * from Fx_GetSalesPersonIDsbyUser('{UserID}')) And companyid=2
